pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg

pl2: Prevent further heat loss: Remove wet clothing, move to a warm environment, blankets & heat packs as needed, allow active movement after 20min if >89.6 ◦ F(32 ◦ C)
Handle very gently if <88 ◦ F(<30 ◦ C) due to risk of arrythmias
In cardiac arrest with temperature <88 ◦ F(<30 ◦ C), limit defibrillations to one shock &
ne Epinephrine until core temp greater than 88 ◦ F (>30 ◦ C) and continue CPR
Consider early transport for active rewarming
pl3: Increase the temperature of transport compartment
Warm IV Isotonic Crystalloid if available – Use of blood warmer if available
